title: Donald Trump is moving the US closer to Russia, and history says that could be a big mistake
description: The new US president has made it clear he would rather negotiate with Moscow than Kyiv when it comes to ending the war in Ukraine, and some say there's good reason to be worried about that.

title: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent Meets Hungarian Foreign Minister to Discuss Economic and Security Priorities
description: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with Hungary's Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto to discuss economic and national security priorities. The discussion highlighted the importance of U.S.-Hungary relations. The meeting did not address Russia-Ukraine tensions, despite Hungary's controversial ties with Russia and past exemptions from sanctions on Gazprombank.

title: Trump-Zelenskiy Feud: A New Dimension to the Russia-Ukraine Conflict
description: The tension between U.S. President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has intensified following Trump's allegations against Zelenskiy. Trump's remarks have raised alarms in Europe about his approach to ending the Russia-Ukraine conflict, potentially favoring Moscow. The situation underscores European concerns and U.S.-Russia dynamics.

title: How Many People Have Died in the Russia-Ukraine War?
description: President Donald Trump recently posted that "millions" have died in the war between Russia and Ukraine. Here are the latest casualties.

title: It took Donald Trump less than a decade to turn the US toward Putin’s Russia
description: President Donald Trump defended the US taking part in peace talks that excluded Ukraine by rewriting history.

title: How Republican Senators Have Shifted Tone on Russia and Ukraine
description: Some of the most vocal critics of Vladimir V. Putin and proponents of the United States’ role as a global defender of democracy have acquiesced to Mr. Trump on Russia.

title: Why Trump is falling into Putin’s trap
description: The US president’s public exchange of insults with Zelensky forms part of a rapid pivot towards Russia, welcomed by the Kremlin.

title: Donald Trump slams Zelenskyy, calls him ‘modestly successful comedian’, ‘dictator’ amid Russia Ukraine peace talks
description: US President Donald Trump, who is negotiating with Russia on ending the war in Ukraine slammed his Ukrainian counterpart for going into a war that couldn’t be won, in a social media post. Calling him a Dictator, Trump wrote, ‘Zelenskyy better move fast or he is not going to have a Country left.’

title: Mike Pence Takes a Swipe at Donald Trump Over Ukraine
description: Pence said that "the Road to Peace must be built on the Truth" after Trump accused Ukraine of starting the war with Russia.

title: Bomb threat at Donald Trump's Doonbeg hotel sparks garda investigation
description: The warning came on the same day that Mr Trump accused Ukraine of starting the three-year war with Russia
